## Notes

Live video-to-video diffusion with text prompts; under 40 ms response, 24 fps; Diffusion Forcing, history augmentation, Hopper kernels, pruning, shortcut distillation; limitations: limited past-frame window, weak object and region control, distortion under extreme style shifts.
